messages.subject: Implementingthe equivalent of geom_density2d
parts:
At the bottom of the Layers guide [1] there's a nice mapping from ggplot2 geoms to vega marks. I'm interested in helping to implement the equivalent for "geom_density2d", if I can. Other than digging through the code on GitHub and eventually submitting a pull request, are there approaches that would lend themselves more or less well to this?

Cheers,
David (@holstius)

[1] http://ggvis.rstudio.com/layers.html

messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: Re: Implementingthe equivalent of geom_density2d
parts:
Not yet, but we're working on it. Basically you'll need to translate
stat_density_2d to an equivalent compute_density_2d (probably
implementing compute_contours along the way), and then write a layer
function that uses mark_path() to draw the results.

It shouldn't be too hard if you take the source from ggplot2 and look
at the source of ggvis to see how things should work. I'm happy to
help if you get stuck, and we'll work on better documentation for
writing layers (although it's still a bit of a shifting target)

Hadley
